name: zai-copilot-chat
displayName: Z.AI Copilot Chat: BYOK 14+ GLM Models
description: Use 14+ Z.AI GLM models (GLM-5.3 flagship 1M context, GLM-5.2, GLM-4.7, free Flash + Vision models) in GitHub Copilot Chat. BYOK, no Copilot Pro needed. Includes @z-research deep-research agent.

zai.temperature.description: Sampling temperature used for chat completions.

zai.maxTokens.description: Optional max output token override. Use 0 to request each Z.AI model's configured maximum.

zai.maxInputTokens.description: Optional context size override advertised to VS Code. Use 0 to advertise each Z.AI model's configured context window.

zai.debugReasoning.description: Write provider reasoning_content to the Z.AI output channel for debugging. Reasoning is not shown in Copilot Chat.

zai.requestTimeout.description: Connection timeout in ms for API requests. During streaming, a separate inactivity timer (half this value, min 90s) aborts if no data arrives. Default 180000 (3 min) — flagship models like glm-5.3 (1M context) need longer cold start than smaller models.

enumDescriptions: Thinking disabled (glm-5.3 maps to 'low' — it cannot disable thinking)
Balanced (glm-5.2 accepts it; glm-5.3 runs 'high'; glm ≤ 5.1 just enables thinking)
Enhanced reasoning — good default for coding
Deepest reasoning (server default) — slowest, most tokens
zai.reasoningEffort.markdownDescription:
Reasoning effort for GLM models, translated per generation:

| Level | glm-5.3+ (forced thinking) | glm-5.2 | glm ≤ 5.1 (toggle only) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `off` | `reasoning_effort: low` | `thinking: disabled` | `thinking: disabled` |
| `low` | `low` | `low` | thinking on |
| `medium` | `high` (no medium on 5.3) | `medium` (server maps to high) | thinking on |
| `high` | `high` | `high` | thinking on |
| `max` | `max` | `max` | thinking on |

Reasoning tokens are billed as output, so lowering this is the single biggest quota saver. Changing it takes effect on the next request — no reload needed.

zai.maxRetries.description: Number of automatic retries on transient network errors (fetch failed, timeout, 5xx). Default 2. Set to 0 to disable retries.

zai.defaultModel.description: Model id to mark as the default selection in the Copilot Chat model picker (e.g. `glm-5.3`). Leave empty to not mark any model as the default — users can still pick any model manually.

zai.showUsageStatusBar.description: Show the latest Z.AI usage summary (prompt→output tokens) in the VS Code status bar after each response.

zai.showQuotaStatusBar.description: Show the Z.AI Coding Plan quota (5-hour / weekly) in the VS Code status bar. Hover for progress bars; click to toggle between windows.

zai.quotaRefreshInterval.description: How often (in minutes) to refresh the Z.AI Coding Plan quota. Set to 0 to disable automatic refresh.

zai.experimentalContextIndicator.description: Experimental: attempt to fill the Copilot Chat context indicator with real Z.AI token usage. Depends on VS Code internals and may break across updates.

zai.research.maxSources.description: Maximum number of sources fetched during a deep research run (`@zai.research /deep`). Lower this to reduce cost and latency.

zai.research.maxIterations.description: Maximum query-expansion iterations before final synthesis. Each iteration searches new queries derived from coverage gaps.

zai.research.concurrency.description: Number of parallel HTTP requests during the search + read phases. Higher is faster but may hit the Z.AI MCP rate limit (~3-5 req/s safe).

zai.research.cacheTTL.description: Cache time-to-live in seconds for Z.AI search and read results. Set to 0 to disable caching. Default 1 hour.

zai.research.synthesisModel.description: Z.AI model used for planning queries and synthesizing the final research report. Use a high-context model (e.g. glm-5.3 with 1M context) for deep research.

zai.research.webSearchToolName.description: VS Code tool name for the Z.AI Web Search MCP server. The default matches the snake_case form VS Code exposes (e.g. `mcp_mcp-web-searc_web_search_prime`). Override if VS Code's MCP tool name format changes.

zai.research.webReaderToolName.description: VS Code tool name for the Z.AI Web Reader MCP server. The default matches the camelCase form VS Code exposes (e.g. `mcp_web-reader-se_webReader`). Override if VS Code's MCP tool name format changes.

zai.visionBridge.enabled.description: Beta: give text-only GLM models image understanding. Attached/pasted images are converted to structured text evidence (OCR, layout, semantics) by the modlens CLI (https://github.com/liustack/modlens) before each request — the Z.AI endpoint still only receives text. Requires `modlens` installed (`npm i -g @liustack/modlens`); run 'Z.AI: Setup Vision Bridge' first. When enabled, all GLM models advertise image input.

zai.visionBridge.bin.description: modlens executable. Accepts a bare command (`modlens`), an absolute path, or a command with leading args (`npx -y @liustack/modlens@3.18.3`). Requires Node.js >= 22.19 on your PATH.

zai.visionBridge.npxBypass.description: When the configured `bin` is unavailable (e.g. modlens not installed globally), automatically fetch modlens through npx on first use and auto-provision a vision engine. Set false to require a manual install.

zai.visionBridge.autoReuse.description: Agent CLIs the bridge may auto-grant (`modlens config set reuse.<harness> true`) to reuse their existing vision model — the zero-API-key path. Only CLIs actually discovered on this machine are granted. Add `claude`/`pi`/`grok` to allow reusing those paid subscriptions (they are excluded by default for consent).

zai.visionBridge.provider.description: Pin one modlens vision engine (`gemini-api`, `openai`, `anthropic`, `antigravity-cli`, `claude-cli`, `kimi-cli`). Leave empty to use modlens' failover chain (fast API providers first, signed-in agent CLIs as backup).

zai.visionBridge.timeoutMs.description: Per-image read timeout passed to modlens (its own default is 180000). The first read of an image takes 5–10s on API engines, 15–45s on agent CLIs; cached reads are instant.

zai.visionBridge.maxEvidenceChars.description: Hard cap for one image's evidence block injected into the conversation (summary, OCR, layout, entities…). Protects smaller-context models from oversized dumps.

zai.visionBridge.announce.description: Emit a short '👁 Reading N attached image(s)…' note while the vision bridge runs, so slow first reads are explained. Turn off for silent operation.

zai.visionBridge.promptTemplate.description: Optional focus prompt forwarded to the vision engine for every image (modlens `--prompt`), e.g. 'focus on UI text and error messages'. Empty = modlens' default full transcription.

zai.visionBridge.cacheTtlHours.description: How long persistent image-evidence cache entries stay valid, in hours. 0 = never expire. VS Code replays the whole conversation every turn, so caching keeps follow-ups from re-reading (and re-billing) images you already sent.

chatParticipants.name: z-research
chatParticipants.description: Multi-iteration research that fetches many sources via Z.AI's Web Search and Web Reader MCP servers and synthesises a cited report.
